flows.title: Run optimization (sync)
flows.description: User triggers Optimize from the SPA; the server runs the optimizer in-process and returns ranked crews in the HTTP response.

steps.label: Click 'Optimize'
steps.detail: Picks ship, hostile, slot constraints, strategy (or 'auto'), warm-start, heuristic seeds.

steps.label: Load warm-start crews
steps.detail: Hydrates previously-good crews from versioned localStorage; prepended to the request.

steps.label: buildOptimizeRequest()
steps.detail: Marshals form state + warm-start into OptimizeRequest JSON.

steps.label: fetch POST /api/optimize
steps.detail: JSON body: ship_id, hostile_id, sims, strategy?, warm_start_crews?, heuristics_seeds?, support_buffs?, …

steps.label: handle_optimize → spawn_blocking
steps.detail: CPU-bound work moved off the Tokio runtime; admission semaphore (KOBAYASHI_MAX_CONCURRENT_CPU_JOBS) gates entry → 503 cpu_busy if no slot.

steps.label: loader::load_*()
steps.detail: Resolves ship, hostile, support buffs, heuristic seeds from in-memory catalogs.

steps.label: optimize_scenario_…()
steps.detail: Auto-routes tiered vs exhaustive from effective candidate count; or honours explicit strategy (tiered|genetic|exhaustive).

steps.label: BuffSet lookup
steps.detail: Officer abilities pre-resolved from officers.lcars.yaml at server start.

steps.label: engine::run_fight() × N sims
steps.detail: Rayon-parallel Monte Carlo; one SplitMix64 PRNG per thread; ranking by win_rate, hull_remaining, r1_kill_rate.

steps.label: OptimizeOutcome
steps.detail: Top crews + effective_strategy + strategy_auto + stats.

steps.label: persist warm-start
steps.detail: Top crews written to localStorage for next run.

flows.title: Run optimization (async + SSE progress)
flows.description: Long-running optimize: server returns a job_id, frontend opens an SSE stream and renders progress until 'done' or 'error'.

steps.label: POST /api/optimize/start
steps.detail: Same body as /api/optimize.

steps.label: handle_optimize_start
steps.detail: Generates job_id, registers entry in OPTIMIZE_JOBS, spawns std::thread for the worker (still admission-gated).

steps.label: insert {status:Running,progress:0}
steps.detail: execution.rs ~L1577.

steps.label: EventSource(/jobs/:id/stream)
steps.detail: Browser opens SSE connection.

steps.label: handle_optimize_job_stream
steps.detail: tokio::spawn loop: every 300ms calls get_job_status and pushes an SSE Event via mpsc channel (routes.rs:982).

steps.label: optimize_scenario_with_progress
steps.detail: Worker thread runs optimize; pushes OptimizeProgressTick callbacks.

steps.label: update progress, progress_preview
steps.detail: Top-k crews so far + percent (execution.rs:494,529).

steps.label: POST /jobs/:id/cancel
steps.detail: Sets cancel flag; worker checks between ticks.

steps.label: final SSE → stream closes
steps.detail: Loop breaks when status == done|error.

flows.title: Simulate a single fight
flows.description: One-shot deterministic fight with a fixed seed. Useful for debugging or scripted comparison.

steps.label: POST /api/simulate
steps.detail: Body: ship, hostile, crew, sims, seed.

steps.label: engine::run_fight() × sims
steps.detail: SplitMix64 PRNG; per-round effect order passive → round_start → sub-rounds → round_end → burning → cleanup.

steps.label: SimulationResponse
steps.detail: Win rate, hull-remaining histogram, r1-kill rate, optional combat trace.

flows.title: Import officer roster
flows.description: User uploads a roster .txt/.json; server parses and persists it for the active profile.

steps.label: Choose roster file
steps.detail: WorkspaceHeader file picker.

steps.label: POST /api/officers/import
steps.detail: api_large_ingest route group (higher body size limit).

steps.label: parse + validate against id_registry
steps.detail: Name aliases resolved via name_aliases.json.

steps.label: write roster
steps.detail: data/import/<file>

steps.label: update active profile
steps.detail: profiles/<id>.json — owned-officer levels, ranks.

flows.title: Sync from STFC Community Mod
flows.description: Quasi-real-time sync: the game mod posts roster/research deltas to /api/sync/ingress; server routes by type and writes to disk.

steps.label: POST /api/sync/ingress
steps.detail: Body = JSON array; type-specific. Header stfc-sync-token must match KOBAYASHI_SYNC_TOKEN if set.

steps.label: ingress_payload()
steps.detail: src/server/sync.rs:79. Logs body_len, identifies sync_type, routes.

steps.label: resolve profile by token
steps.detail: Matches stfc-sync-token to a profile entry; 401 otherwise.

steps.label: apply officer/research batch
steps.detail: Updates owned-officer levels or research state for the resolved profile.

steps.label: write updated profile
steps.detail: Same file the optimizer reads — recommendations stay in sync.

flows.title: Refresh ship catalog from data.stfc.space
flows.description: Maintainer pulls fresh ship JSON from data.stfc.space, rebuilds the ID registry, and normalizes to the extended schema the server consumes.

steps.label: node fetch_stfcspace_ships.mjs
steps.detail: Default: missing-only; --full re-downloads every id in summary-ship.json.

steps.label: write data/upstream/data-stfc-space/ships/<id>.json
steps.detail: Raw upstream JSON cached on disk.

steps.label: python3 build_ship_registry.py
steps.detail: Reads upstream summary-ship + translations.

steps.label: write ship_id_registry
steps.detail: data/officers/ ship registry (used by hull_id_registry workflow too).

steps.label: cargo run --bin normalize_data_stfc_space
steps.detail: Normalizes to extended schema with tiers + levels (Option B).

steps.label: write ships_extended/<id>.json + index.json
steps.detail: Carries data_version + source_note.

steps.label: (on next server start) load
steps.detail: mod-data::loader reads ships_extended/index.json at startup.

flows.title: Refresh hostile catalog
flows.description: Same pattern as ships, but for hostiles — fetch raw upstream JSON, then normalize into data/hostiles/.

steps.label: node fetch_stfcspace_hostiles.mjs
steps.detail: Default missing-only; --full re-downloads all.

steps.label: cargo run --bin normalize_hostiles_stfc_space
steps.detail: Optional env: STFCSPACE_HOSTILES_VERSION, _SOURCE_NOTE.

steps.label: write hostiles/<id>.json + index.json
steps.detail: Numeric string ids; merge-updates data/registry.json (hostiles entry only).

flows.title: Regenerate LCARS officer definitions
flows.description: Officer abilities are authored in officers.canonical.json (or scripts after an upstream refresh) and compiled to officers.lcars.yaml, which the engine loads.

steps.label: Edit officers.canonical.json
steps.detail: Maintainer-curated catalog. After upstream officer cache refresh: python3 scripts/normalize_officer_id_strings.py first.

steps.label: cargo run --bin generate_lcars
steps.detail: Or: cargo xtask regen-lcars.

steps.label: write officers.lcars.yaml
steps.detail: Monolithic YAML — only *.lcars.yaml files in the dir are loaded.

steps.label: restart ./target/release/kobayashi serve
steps.detail: From project root so data/ and frontend/dist resolve.

steps.label: lcars::load_lcars_dir('data/officers')
steps.detail: src/cli.rs:481.

steps.label: BuffSet available
steps.detail: Static buffs + per-round effects + triggered effects, pre-resolved before any fight loop.

flows.title: Server startup — what loads from where
flows.description: What gets loaded into memory the moment 'kobayashi serve' boots, before any HTTP request is served.

steps.label: ./target/release/kobayashi serve
steps.detail: Binds 127.0.0.1:3000 (override with KOBAYASHI_BIND). Run from project root.

steps.label: load catalogs
steps.detail: src/cli.rs:run_with_args.

steps.label: officers.canonical.json
steps.detail: Maintainer catalog.

steps.label: heuristics/*.txt
steps.detail: Community-known crew seeds.

steps.label: profiles/*.json
steps.detail: Active profile + roster + research.

steps.label: lcars::load_lcars_dir(data/officers)
steps.detail: Only *.lcars.yaml is loaded; unknown effect types are skipped with a warning.

steps.label: build Axum Router + spawn runtime
steps.detail: src/server/mod.rs creates the multi-thread Tokio runtime and routes::build_router().
